forcreators.title: PyNumStore - For creators
forcreators.text-1: Scripts are listed only if the name of their creator is registered. To add your name to the database, enter it above.
forcreators.text-2: The scripts are updated automatically every 24 hours. Changes you make will not be immediately visible.
forcreators.text-3: To add tags to your scripts, insert the following element anywhere in the script's description on NumWorks:
forcreators.text-4: PyNumStore will automatically detect and index the tags. You can see an example of this on NumWorks and on PyNumStore.
forcreators.text-5: For any complaints or requests, please contact me at my email address: gradient01.dev@gmail.com
forcreators.invalid: "{name}" is not a valid creator name. Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens are allowed, and it cannot start or end with a hyphen.
forcreators.success: "{name}" has been successfully added to the database!
forcreators.too_many_requests: Too many requests. Please try again later.
forcreators.not_found: "{name}" doesn't exist on the NumWorks website.

legal.title: PyNumStore - Legal Notices
legal.publisher-text: This website is published by an individual developer operating under the pseudonym Gradient01
legal.hosting-text: PyNumStore is hosted by GitHub Pages, a service provided by GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States. (pages.github.com)
legal.relation-text-1: PyNumStore is an independent, non-commercial project with no affiliation to NumWorks SAS. The NumWorks name, logo, and all associated trademarks are the exclusive property of NumWorks SAS.
legal.relation-text-2: PyNumStore is not designed to replace the official NumWorks platform — it acts as a layer built on top of it. It provides a search and discovery interface for Python scripts that creators have already published publicly on my.numworks.com. Every script page links directly back to the official NumWorks website. PyNumStore does not host script source code and does not allow users to publish, modify, or delete scripts.
legal.relation-text-3: PyNumStore exists only because the official NumWorks platform does not currently offer cross-creator search or discovery features. Should NumWorks implement equivalent functionality in the future, this website will be closed, as its sole purpose will have been fulfilled by the original platform.
legal.content-text-1: All Python scripts indexed on PyNumStore are the intellectual property of their respective creators. PyNumStore only reproduces the publicly visible information available on the official NumWorks website — script name, creator, description, and a preview screenshot — for informational purposes. No copyright claim is made over any of this content.
legal.content-text-2: If you are the author of a script and wish to have it removed from PyNumStore, please contact gradient01.dev@gmail.com and the content will be removed promptly.
legal.content-text-3: The PyNumStore source code (excluding indexed content) is published under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
legal.privacy-text-1: PyNumStore does not collect any personal data directly and does not require any account or registration. It does set one cookie of its own, pns_lang, which stores your language preference; as a strictly functional cookie required for a feature you explicitly use, it does not require consent.
legal.privacy-text-2: This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to collect anonymous, aggregated visit statistics such as pages viewed and approximate geographic location. This privacy-first tool does not use cookies and does not track individual visitors across sites. Data is processed by Cloudflare, Inc. in accordance with its Privacy Policy.
legal.disclaimer-text-1: PyNumStore is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. The content indexed on this website is retrieved automatically from the NumWorks platform and may not always be up to date. PyNumStore is not responsible for the content of scripts published by creators on the NumWorks platform.
legal.disclaimer-text-2: The availability and accuracy of the data depend on the structure and availability of the NumWorks website. PyNumStore may stop working or be shut down at any time without notice.
